description: activity send durably appends one v=1/crc32 'event=message' record to the RECIPIENT's own routing.log (never the sender's), gated by a directional [activity.pairs] entry; activity inbox --peek reads it back without advancing the recipient's cursor. --peek is used rather than a bare inbox read because inbox's default acknowledge path refuses outside an orchestrator pane (MULTIVERSE_TASK_ID set means 'a dispatched specialist', never advance the cursor it depends on) — a real behavior worth a scenario of its own later, not this one.

stdout_contains: sequence numbers are per project and cannot be compared across projects.

.multiverse/routing.log.regex: ^<TIMESTAMP>	v=1	seq=1	event=message	id=fixed-msg-1	from=sandbox	to=sandbox2	body="hello there"	crc32=<CRC32>$
